name: B10-0067/2025 (PfE) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Iran's human rights record, especially the treatment of women and religious and ethnic minorities. It asks Iran to free two named women, Pakshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and to release detained EU nationals and prisoners of conscience. It also asks the Council of the EU to add more people to the EU sanctions list and urges EU institutions to stop funding campaigns that promote the hijab.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It targets Iran's authorities and EU institutions, and names two detained women.
- Next, the resolution goes to the relevant parties; no binding action follows.
